about: Warman is a city in central Saskatchewan just north of Saskatoon, one of the province’s fastest-growing bedroom communities on the prairie. Family neighbourhoods, a compact commercial core, and quick highway access to Saskatoon define a young urban centre in the Saskatoon metro orbit. About 14,000 people live in Warman.
seoSummary: Fast-growing city north of Saskatoon—prairie bedroom community with family neighbourhoods and metro access.
